title: Hello Secret: Smart Language Decoder & Secret Communication Tool
image1Description: A web application resolving incorrect keyboard language inputs and providing message encryption for maximum privacy.

section1.heading: Inspiration
section1.content: This project stems from observing two main issues in digital communication: the time lost when forgetting to switch keyboard languages, and the need for 'Advanced Privacy' when sending sensitive data via standard chat apps. I initiated 'Hello Secret' to serve as both a recovery tool for mistyped language inputs and an encryption channel, ensuring that critical messages are understood only by the intended sender and receiver.

section2.heading: Concept and Design
section2.content: I designed the application with two primary modes. The first is 'Language Mapping,' which uses an algorithm to convert mistyped text based on keyboard character coordinates. The second is 'Secret Encryption,' allowing users to encrypt messages before sending. The recipient must then decode the message through the web app using the same algorithm. This adds a robust security layer to daily communication.

section3.heading: Challenges and Solutions
section3.content: The major challenge was preventing brute-force attempts to guess the decoding algorithm. I addressed this by implementing a 'Symmetric Key' system, requiring users to set a shared password before transacting. Additionally, to handle special characters and emojis that often cause encryption distortion, I utilized Data Encoding techniques to ensure that the core message remains 100% intact and accurate through complex encryption and decryption cycles.

section4.heading: Opportunities for Further Development
section4.content: In the future, 'Hello Secret' can be elevated to international security standards by integrating 'Time-based OTP Keys' to ensure passwords expire over time. I also plan to add a 'Burn-on-read' feature—automatically destroying data after the first viewing. These enhancements aim to serve corporate and personal privacy needs under the concept 'A secret must remain a secret forever,' setting a new standard for data security in the chat-dominated world.
